items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: His second Marshall at that time was old man Alexander. He's dead too now.

ctx.x: Well who's behind him? Let's see. In the back of him. The second Marshall.

The second Marshall. His second Marshall at that time was old man Alexander. He's dead too now. He's dead too now. He said that was the next Marshall after he died. You know the old man Alexander. Well he dropped dead you know. He was the second Marshall at that time.
He has to look after that and he has the second Marshall to help him.
